units: pixels and seconds; image coordinates x right, y down, full-resolution 1080x1920

camera.motion: static (consecutive-frame difference over sky/house < 0.05 grey levels; no pan, zoom or shake)
camera.view: side view, near-horizontal; house facade faces the camera; motion of all animals is left->right, parallel to the facade, i.e. in a plane facing the camera
camera.note_2D: scene given as 2D: use a single metres-per-pixel scale. Ground-contact rows differ slightly (chestnut hooves y~1048, pale horse hooves y~1055, rabbit bottom y~1062-1066), i.e. the rabbit is a little nearer the camera than the pale horse, and the pale horse a little nearer than the chestnut horse; apparent sizes of all three are constant over the clip (no depth change).

chestnut_horse.description: reddish-brown (chestnut) horse with grey-brown head and white socks, on the LEFT, walking right in front of the brick ground floor; the trailing horse
chestnut_horse.occlusion: none (fully visible; lower hooves partly in grass)
chestnut_horse.special: ANIMATION LOOP RESET: between frame 48 and 49 the chestnut horse jumps back from mask_cx 385.5 to 234.6 (its frame-0 position, -151 px in one frame). It does not walk back; frames 0-48 are one continuous walk to the right.

pale_horse.description: light beige / cream (palomino-like) horse with darker mane and tail, in the MIDDLE/RIGHT, walking right, leading the chestnut horse by ~260 px

rabbit.description: small brown rabbit/hare hopping right on the grass just in front of (ahead of) the pale horse's front hooves, near the wall base
rabbit.occlusion: bottom (feet) partly hidden by grass blades; mask bottom often clipped at y=1066 by the processing cut, true bottom ~1062-1068

house.description: two-storey half-timbered house filling the background; brick ground floor with three arched windows, cream timber-framed upper storey with large central wooden shutter, gabled shingle roof

grass_field.description: green grass lawn from the wall base / horizon (y~988 at the image sides) to the bottom of the frame; tall grass blades in the foreground

red_flower_1.description: small red flower in the grass, left-middle

red_flower_2.description: small red/orange flower in the grass, right, lower

sky_clouds.description: blue sky with clouds above/around the house (static backdrop)

events.what: all three animals already moving right at the first frame (no start of motion inside the clip)
last frame of the chestnut horse's continuous walk
chestnut horse teleports back to its frame-0 position (loop reset, -151 px in x); pale horse and rabbit continue normally
clip ends; all animals still moving

no_contact: animals never touch each other; the rabbit stays 5-40 px ahead of the pale horse's front hoof (touch_other=1 only at frame 23 from mask dilation, masks 5 px apart)
reference_point_note: mask_cx/mask_cy = centroid of the full silhouette (best proxy of the body centre / rig root in x); bbox_cx/bbox_cy = box centre. For gait-independent horizontal motion use mask_cx (leg swing moves it by ~1-3 px). A horse rig root is usually at the pelvis/body centre, close to mask_cy (~960 px for both horses).
